entries.summary: Scaffold or convert an owned skill into a script-backed executable tool, invocation index, referenced contracts, and license.
entries.usage: python3 skills/learn/skills/skillify/scripts/skillify.py scaffold --target <absent-target> --name <kebab-name> --description <description> --backend <python|ai-sdk>; or convert <owned-skill> --dry-run. Complete and execute the actual workflow, then check --require-tool per guide.

entries.summary: Scaffold isolated native CLI lint rule examples with fixtures and dependency locks.
entries.usage: python3 skills/learn/skills/lintify/scripts/lintify.py scaffold --backend <eslint|lintbook|gptlint> --target <absent-target>; adapt to the real rule and validate with the native engine.

entries.summary: Scaffold a native executable workflow definition with code bindings and examples.
entries.usage: python3 skills/learn/skills/flowify/scripts/flowify.py scaffold --backend <maf|rhai> --target <absent-target> --name <name>; verify actual runtime and behavior per guide.

entries.summary: Plan and apply owned scoped agent instructions with drift and ownership checks.
entries.usage: python3 skills/learn/skills/instructify/scripts/instructify.py plan --project <repo> --input <manifest>; inspect the plan before using the documented apply/check commands.

entries.summary: Generate a Python configuration module from typed validated Copier inputs without model inference.
entries.usage: copier copy --defaults --data display_name=<label> --data worker_limit=<1..32> skills/learn/skills/reusify/examples/copier <absent-output>; use a compatible installed Copier and validate output.

entries.summary: Version-pinned Vercel AI SDK boundary for explicit chat/Responses, native Decisions, and official harness profiles with bounded capacity.
entries.usage: Import createInference from inference.ts and supply an explicit configuration; invoke language, decide, or harness only for the workflow residual. Use the native lock/check/test commands in the guide.

entries.summary: Resolve explicit workspace/user/global tkstack roots, isolate ignored temporary sessions, and preserve private-state Git policy with bounded writer ownership.
entries.usage: tkstack_state.py locations; path|init --scope <workspace|user|global> --session <id> --namespace <name>. Import state_root/state_path/session_path/session_tempdir for explicit ownership.

entries.summary: Compile once-lowered prompt/Markdown procedures into reproducible verified code-bearing lock artifacts; execute frozen code without reinterpreting source.
entries.usage: codify.py scaffold <source> --target <absent-dir>; implement the native workflow, then compile <source> --entrypoint <cli> --cases <contracts> --output <artifact>; run <artifact> --input <json>.

entries.summary: Collect bounded scoped session evidence and deterministically route explicit abstract findings into the smallest ___ify action graph.
entries.usage: learn.py sessions review [--session <id>] [--save]; then sessions plan --snapshot <snapshot.json> --input <semantic-decisions.json> [--save]. Execute selected skills through the authored consolidation procedure.

entries.summary: Provision reproducible agent dotfiles through a single noninteractive entrypoint with private prerequisites, bounded runtime workers, scoped initialization, owned configuration, and verification.
entries.usage: ./install.sh [--profile dotfiles|devcontainer|codex-cloud] [--target <home-or-project> --scope home|project] [--workspace <project>]; use --dry-run/--check for read-only operations or --offline for cached startup.

entries.summary: Resolve private runtime prerequisites for host-launched tools and installers while preserving supplied authentication, proxy, and CA variables.
entries.usage: Import with_paths(root, environment=None) to obtain an independent environment mapping with existing private bin paths prepended; launch the owned child with that mapping.

entries.summary: Validate Markdown/YAML command signatures and deterministically map nested CLI commands, aliases, typed flags, or OpenAI tool calls to the same verified compiled artifact.
entries.usage: codify.py commands <package> --format responses|chat; invoke <package> -- <command> [args] or invoke <package> --call <tool-call.json>. Author commands/*.md and compile with their matching implementation.

entries.summary: Discover scoped skill/workflow packages and invoke their frozen Codify commands or locks with selected existing inference profiles and independent child environments.
entries.usage: .tkstack/tkstack skills <name> -- <command> [arguments]; workflows <package-or-lock>; list|tools|check for read-only discovery. Install into an explicit scope using runner_install.py.

entries.summary: Compare source/document review snapshots and generated README facts, using live files or the actual Git index; shared by native completion hooks and pre-commit.
entries.usage: check_docs.py check [--staged]; render generated README facts; explicitly review and refresh --area <name> --reason <actual-review>; --no-doc-impact documents internal-only exceptions.

entries.summary: SQLite WAL task coordination, expiring fenced ownership, Git/proof readiness, and explicit issue/workload/ADR revisions.
entries.usage: .tkstack/tkstack skills sdlc -- tasks init|status|claim|heartbeat|finish|quiesce|recover|issue|revise|history|gate --run <run> --actor <owner> ...; see typed commands/*.md. Use local .tkstack/sdlc state and actual quiescence evidence.

entries.summary: One metadata/signature-derived man-page model with escaped man(1) source and fixed console rendering for shared reserved help.
entries.usage: Use command_schema.help_text/execute for reserved help, or command_manual.render(identity, command_items, topic, format). Keep signatures and metadata authoritative; no host pager/formatter, model calls, timestamps, or state writes.

entries.summary: Canonical typed skill contract/report verification and bounded native helper transport.
entries.usage: Use Skillify normalize from an explicit contract profile; all distributed runtime copies derive from this owner.

entries.summary: One strict duplicate/non-finite/overflow JSON parser for compiler, command protocol and packaged skill cores.
entries.usage: Import loads or retain existing parse_json/json_value aliases. Keep size limits at the actual file/input boundary.

entries.summary: Generate typed model/verify/native interfaces while preserving native code and source-generation ownership.
entries.usage: skillify normalize <skill> --profile <contract.json> --dry-run; review/apply, update docs/cases/index/version, then compile and run conformance.

entries.summary: Read-only inventory-wide skill schema, shared source, generator, metadata, split and artifact freshness CLI gate.
entries.usage: python3 scripts/tool.py command-schema -B scripts/check_skills.py; doctor and CI call the same shared validators.
